scruff.alt.hint: What is in the picture, for anyone who cannot see it. Goes with the picture to every place that takes one.
scruff.bar.hint: Cleaning takes the metadata out and writes the file again. Posting cleans first, then sends the draft everywhere that is ticked.
scruff.bluesky.hint: An app password, not your account password. Make one under Settings, Privacy and security, App passwords. It can be revoked there without touching anything here.
scruff.carries: This file carries information that would go out with it:
scruff.clean.folder.hint: Writes a cleaned copy of every file into the output folder. The originals are not touched.
scruff.clean.inplace.hint: Replaces each original with its cleaned copy. The original goes to the Recycle Bin first.
scruff.description: Takes the metadata out of pictures before they go anywhere, and posts them to Bluesky and Mastodon, or hands them to the sites that have to be done by hand.
scruff.empty: Drop pictures or a folder here. Each one is read and its metadata shown before anything is done to it.
scruff.error.notapicture: {0} is not a picture this can read
scruff.field.caption: Caption
scruff.field.title: TITLE
scruff.kind.handoff: opened in the browser, fields to paste
scruff.mastodon.hint: A personal access token from your server: Preferences, Development, New application, with write scope. Copy the access token, not the client key.
scruff.note.gifstill: {0} will go as a still, since this place does not take GIF
scruff.note.shrink: {0} will be shrunk to fit under {1}
scruff.outcome.handed: The page and the folder are open. Paste the fields and attach the files.
scruff.outcome.skipped: Skipped, because of what is written above
scruff.post.hint: Cleans every file, fits it to each ticked place, and posts. Places done by hand open in the browser with a sheet to paste from.
scruff.problem.format: {0} is a {1}, which this place does not take, and it cannot be converted
scruff.problem.noadult: Instagram does not allow adult work under any rating
scruff.problem.nothing: Nothing to post: no pictures and no text
scruff.problem.toobig: {0} is over {1} and cannot be made smaller
scruff.problem.toomany: Takes {0} pictures at most, and there are {1}
scruff.problem.toomanytags: Takes {0} hashtags at most, and there are {1}
scruff.rating.note: Becomes a self label on Bluesky, the sensitive flag on Mastodon, and a reminder on the sheet everywhere else.
scruff.remind.crop: One of the pictures is taller than 4:5 or wider than 1.91:1, so Instagram will crop it
scruff.remind.onebyone: Each picture is its own submission there, so this is {0} of them
scruff.status.cleaned: Cleaned {0} files, {1} of which carried something
scruff.status.posted: {0} posted, {1} handed over, {2} did not go
scruff.status.start: Add pictures, write the post once, tick where it goes.
scruff.subreddit.hint: without the r/, or empty to be asked
scruff.tags.hint: comma separated, or just spaces for one word tags
scruff.tags.note: Written once. They become hashtags where hashtags are used, and underscore keywords on FurAffinity.
scruff.text.hint: What goes with it. Every place gets this, after the title if there is one.
scruff.title.hint: Some places have a title box; the rest get it as the first line.
scruff.turned.note: The picture is stored on its side and only looks right because of a tag. Cleaning turns the pixels so it still looks right once the tag is gone.
